tools.name: List Registered Assets
tools.purpose: Lists content-addressed registered assets with SHA-256 and dimensions.

tools.name: Verify Asset Integrity
tools.purpose: Streams on-disk bytes to verify SHA-256 integrity and detect tampering.

tools.name: Apply Approved Canon Mutation
tools.purpose: Applies an approved canon mutation proposal incrementing the Story Bible snapshot.

tools.name: Inspect Canonical Characters
tools.purpose: Inspect character invariants, visual specs, tolerances, restrictions, and canonical anchor hash.

tools.name: Inspect Reference Anchor
tools.purpose: Inspects canonical reference image anchor, dimensions, SHA-256 digest, and invariants.

tools.name: Propose Canon Mutation
tools.purpose: Draft a structured character or style mutation proposal for human review.

tools.name: Set Canonical Reference Anchor
tools.purpose: Registers an existing registered asset or approved portrait as the canonical reference anchor for a Story Bible character.

asset_id.description: Asset ID of the reference image in AssetRegistry

tools.name: Add Expressive Speech Bubble
tools.purpose: Places short audible dialogue from a named selected character, or internal thoughts in a thought bubble. Choose the bubble style from dialogue delivery and story emotion/action context. Automatically measures the artwork's focal subject, avoids the subject and existing lettering, and points the tail at a saved speaker anchor or clearly labeled single-cast visual estimate; it fails when safe placement cannot be established.

text.description: Exact spoken words for this selected character. Keep newly drafted lines brief; preserve exact creator-authored wording without truncation.

layer_id.description: Optional stable bubble layer ID for idempotent retries.

speaker_character_id.description: Stable Story Bible ID for the character who speaks this line. In Agent chat this must be one of the creator-selected characters; required when more than one character is selected.

emotional_intent.description: The speaker's current delivery/emotion in this beat; used to choose the bubble treatment.

narrative_function.description: Beat role such as reveal, reaction, or dialogue.

delivery.description: How the character says the line, such as whisper, shout, calm, robotic, or remote.

action_context.description: Short action context only when it affects how the character speaks.

story_event.description: Narrative event for this panel; use only cues that affect the speaker's delivery.

dialogue_text.description: The exact dialogue, used to detect clear emphasis such as a shout or stammer; never rewritten.

bubble_preset_id.description: Stable ID from canvas.search_bubble_presets; applies its real shape, tail, accent, and style.

tail_target.description: A saved speaker anchor. Agent calls must not invent this point; when absent, the runtime uses an explicitly labeled detected focal-subject estimate for a single selected character.

font_family.description: Use Comic Neue for readable dialogue, Bangers for short sound effects, or a verified project font.

tools.name: Assemble Full Comic Page
tools.purpose: One-shot autonomous page assembly: creates page with template, places artwork into panels, and positions expressive speech bubbles pointing towards characters.

speaker_character_id.description: Stable Story Bible ID for the voice; use explicit beat speaker IDs, never infer from the character count.

tools.name: Composite Full Page to High-DPI Image
tools.purpose: Renders all panels, artwork, vector masks, bubbles, lettering, and borders of a saved page into a high-DPI 300 DPI composite PNG.

tools.name: Scratch Custom Canvas Page
tools.purpose: Creates a new persisted editable page from custom panel rectangles or polygon cuts. Supply normalized geometry (0–1) inside the usable page area; IDs and reading order are stable and validated before the page is saved.

panel_geometry.description: One object per panel in normalized usable-area coordinates. Use rect for a rectangle or polygon for a custom scratch-cut; each polygon point is x/y from 0 to 1.

panel_plans.description: Optional validated story beats to attach to matching custom panel IDs.

tools.name: Create Page from Template
tools.purpose: Creates a new editable comic page using a canonical template or one of 100 searchable stable-ID panel layout recipes. Search a recipe first when the creator describes a narrative use case.

content_kind.description: Meaning of the text: audible spoken dialogue, internal thought, narration, SFX, or none. Scene/action descriptions are not dialogue.

carrier.description: Visual holder matched to meaning: spoken/emotional speech uses speech_bubble; internal_thought uses thought_bubble; narration uses caption or narration_box; omit with none.

text_content.description: Exact creator-authored/approved wording, or the exact Agent-drafted line explicitly present in this typed plan. For newly drafted audible dialogue, aim for 8 words or fewer and never exceed 12; preserve creator wording even when longer. Omit text rather than filling every panel.
text_content.title: Text Content

speaker_id.description: Stable ID of the selected canonical character who speaks or thinks this text. For story-local characters, leave this empty and use speaker_name; the compiler assigns a job-local ID.

speaker_name.description: Exact name of a visible story-local character who speaks or thinks this text. Use only when the story has no creator-selected Canon cast; never invent a Canon ID.

PanelTextPlan.title: PanelTextPlan

PanelTransitionType.description: Qualitative narrative relationship between this panel and the preceding panel.

template_parameters.description: Typed parameters supported by the selected layout template, such as row/column ratios.

panel_plans.description: Optional S5 plans to attach to the matching page panels in this same persisted Canvas document.

tools.name: Detect Character Anchor
tools.purpose: Measures a likely focal-subject bounding box from the panel's placed artwork and returns a head-area tail estimate plus safe-space measurements. This is an image-analysis estimate, not identity recognition; it fails when no usable artwork is present.

tools.name: Generate Canvas Layout
tools.purpose: Generates page layout panels conforming to margins, gutters, bleed, and safe area.

tools.name: Inspect Canvas Panel Spacing
tools.purpose: Reads the saved Canvas page and measures panel-to-panel gaps and actual trim-edge clearance from stored rectangle/polygon boundaries. Returns measurements plus configured margins/gutters and does not mutate geometry.

panel_id.description: Optional panel whose nearest neighbors should be returned.

tools.name: List Canvas Templates
tools.purpose: Lists all deterministic manga and comic page layout templates.

tools.name: Place Artwork in Panel
tools.purpose: Places a registered or generated artwork image into an editable page panel slot with aspect-ratio-safe fit.

tools.name: Reshape Canvas Panel Geometry
tools.purpose: Directs custom panel polygon or rectangle coordinates on an editable page (angles, wedges, slanted gutters, or bleeds).

tools.name: Find Speech Bubble Presets
tools.purpose: Search 50 stable-ID speech bubble presets by dialogue intent and use case. Return the exact preset ID, implemented shape/tail/accent, styling, and Pinterest inspiration search for canvas.add_speech_bubble.

tools.name: Find Panel Layout Recipes
tools.purpose: Search 100 stable-ID panel layout recipes by narrative use case (reveal, dialogue, action, chase, pause, comedy, suspense, aftermath). Return IDs, geometry template, Pinterest inspiration search, and Agent guidance before creating a page.

tools.name: Switch Page Layout Template
tools.purpose: Switches an existing page's grid template to a new layout while preserving or remapping placed artwork and text layers.

tools.name: Refine Speech Bubble
tools.purpose: Refines an existing bubble on the same persisted page while preserving its stable ID. Recomputes real bubble and tail vectors after changing shape, position, text, font, or tail anchor.

scale.description: Uniform zoom multiplier to scale width, height, and font_size proportionally.

tools.name: Verify Persisted Canvas Page
tools.purpose: Checks the persisted page revision, panel order, artwork asset integrity, and expected editable text records. It does not claim visual character verification.

tools.name: Plan Page Lettering
tools.purpose: Plan concise, source-grounded dialogue, thoughts, captions, or silence for every panel of the supplied saved Canvas job. Use only the saved panel IDs and selected characters provided in context. Spoken words require a selected speaker. Do not turn visual actions into dialogue, do not fill every panel with text, and do not generate or alter artwork or page geometry.

tools.name: Plan Narrative Panels
tools.purpose: Convert a supplied story into per-panel narrative, shot, composition, transition, and text-carrier decisions. Requires scene_id and non-empty beats; the coordinator may derive source-grounded beats from the creator's story text and explicit panel count. This does not generate images or page geometry.
